tts_lines: Incline dumbbell press. Flared elbows dump the load onto your front delts.
Tuck to about sixty degrees and your upper chest takes it.

caption.title: Your incline press is hitting your shoulders, not your upper chest.
caption.question: Where do you feel your incline press most, chest or shoulders?
caption.save: Save this for your next chest day.

source.note: 3D mannequin with real 3D matte-black shorts, equipment and anatomy are rendered inside the source clip; the pipeline only regrades native pixels

target_zoom.why: t567u: whole figure centred horizontally (t558 M10); Day 4 full-body framing, no zoom | t578: v2 clips: dumbbells/bench extend right of the keypoint bbox -> focus_x 548 centres the silhouette

wrong.why: t578: new grok clip (one take). Window (reversed: lockout -> bottom, so the Day 4 peak = deep bottom where the elbow angle and glow show) = last bottom (f100, wristY 422/1280) -> lockout (f144). 2D upper-arm/torso angle at bottom 89/52 deg (near/far arm), elbow-span 2.47x shoulder span

right.why: t588/t589: redone right clip (one take). Window reversed lockout f114 -> deepest bottom f80 (wristY 468/1280 vs wrong 418: deeper). Bottom 2D upper-arm angle 71/29 deg (near/far) vs wrong 84/50 (17 deg mean difference); elbow span 2.26x vs 2.47x shoulder width (8.5% narrower) => ~60-65 deg tuck

rejected_clips.why: xAI edits rejected (t529u acceptance QC); never use

mistake_type_why: t567u/t568u owner: muscle-fibre-only 2-step variant (no bone X-Ray). The shown consequence is the load shift front delt vs upper pec.
camera_plan_note: t568u 2-step plan: 1 wrong/front, 2 right/front. Only one native camera exists for Day 6 muscle clips (elevated front-3/4, same for both); the right clip is the mirrored side so both face the same way.
callouts_note: t557u: callouts are derived per motion (motions.*.callout) - steps 1/3 and 2/4 share angle + label

callout_axis.why: t567u: callout axis follows the upper arm (shoulder -> elbow), short torso reference

source_clips_note: wrong = output/assets/day6_v2_wrong_720p.mp4, right = output/assets/day6_v3_right_720p.mp4 (both 1088x1920 24fps 6.04s); *_src720.mp4 = 4px side crop + lanczos to 720x1280
clean_plate_why: t578: v2 clips have a lighter centre backdrop (vignette); the t567 clean plate's border-gradient reference is darker, so it picked the dark arm over the real backdrop and made ghosts. The plain temporal median is clean here.

metal_lum_max_why: t578: dark hex dumbbells <=42; the charcoal forearm/upper-arm skin (40-90) is body, not metal
flat_look_why: t591u/t592u: Day 4 look restored - flat 35/39/43 backdrop (no vignette plate, no floor shadow) + one even skin curve over all skin (no dark shaded side); QC (bg)/(sh)
